## The claim

No exon of a reachable target-set gene, nor any such gene pooled, falls below the 2.5th percentile of a 1,000-exon null copy-number band measured on this sample.

**Prediction if true.** Alignment-free copy number, computed against a local flanking denominator and reported with its surviving unique-k-mer count, leaves every measured target exon or pooled gene inside the null band.

**What would refute it.** One falls below the 2.5th percentile, which makes it a deletion candidate for step 6 after checking which side of the baited-span and minimum-length controls any contradicting structural-variant call sits on.
